name: Saraf
title: Descendant of Shelah who ruled in Moab
summary: Saraf is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of Shelah, son of Judah. He is described as one who ruled in Moab and returned to Bethlehem. Little else is known about him beyond this genealogical reference.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Saraf is listed as a descendant of Shelah, son of Judah, in a genealogical record in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Ruled in Moab
keyEvents.description: Saraf is described as one who ruled in Moab, suggesting he held a leading position in this area east of the Dead Sea.

keyEvents.title: Returned to Bethlehem
keyEvents.description: According to the text, Saraf and his relatives returned to Bethlehem, linking them to the core area of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Part of Shelah's descendants
keyEvents.description: Saraf belonged to the lineage of Shelah, who was the third son of Judah and his Canaanite wife Bath-Shua. This lineage had special craft and leadership duties.
